Mats, viewing, and care

Our mats are clean and open. Partners have room to train with care. A waiting area sits by the door. Students learn safety rules before partner drills.

We clean the mats each day. We clean spots that people touch. Classes are small. Sandy watches and guides each student.

Kids and teens share a class. Sandy picks partners and tasks. New adults start at their own pace. Meet Sandy for a first visit.
